name: Meera
title: The seat by the window
story: My grandmother and I used to split one filter kaapi every Sunday, right by that corner window. She's gone now, but every time I sit there I still hear her telling me to slow down and drink it properly, not gulp it like a bus was waiting.

name: Arun
title: First rain, first job offer
story: I got my first offer letter sitting in this cafe during the first rain of the season. The power went out, the whole place lit candles, and a stranger two tables away bought me a badam milk to celebrate. I never learned her name.

name: Priya
title: The murukku thief
story: My little brother once ate an entire plate of murukku that was meant for four of us before we'd even sat down properly, then blamed it on the cat that doesn't exist. We still bring it up every single time we're here.
